summary: Iter 68 · Worker telemetry + SystemSignalLight fully validated. All 11 pytest backend tests + all 6 Playwright UI assertions PASS. Signal light correctly reflects green/yellow/red state transitions (pause flips to yellow, fault-injection flips to red, healthy is green with animate-ping).
critical_code_review_comments: worker_telemetry.compute_system_status swallows exceptions in get_all_workers (good — telemetry must not crash), but a completely empty heartbeats collection currently yields level='red' label='Unknown'. Consider whether a brand-new deployment (before any worker has ticked) should start as yellow/warming-up rather than red — currently a fresh boot shows red for the first ~5 min until scheduler_loop ticks.
compute_system_status re-reads env vars on every call · fine for correctness, but would miss a live env change without a restart (low priority).

PortalOpsPage.jsx is 4073 lines — exceeds the >700-line guideline. Suggest extracting OutboundTab, SystemSignalLight, and KPI cards into separate files for maintainability (not blocking this iteration).

The SystemSignalLight reads status from `dash?.system_status` (dashboard poll) rather than the dedicated /worker-status endpoint. This is fine since they return identical structure, but worth documenting the single-source-of-truth.
seed_data_creation: Fault-injection test creates TEST_stale_worker_iter68 doc in worker_heartbeats and temporarily marks scheduler_loop/business_activation_nurture as stale — cleanup runs in finally block to restore fresh state.
